column1: # VCI-100MKII — Vestax "VCI-100MKII 取扱説明書" (Japanese owner's manual), MIDI MAP pp. 45-47 (scanned, transcribed by eye)
# Note names are converted with C-1 = 0 (the convention of the VCI-100 MIDI map, e.g. C3 = 30h). Deck A = ch 1,
# B = ch 2, C = ch 3, D = ch 4, browser/crossfader/shift = ch 5. LEDs take the button's note on the deck's channel.
# The EQ knobs are printed as EQ_Hi_Hi/EQ_Mid_Hi/EQ_Mid/EQ_Low but the panel labels them HI/MID/LOW/PAN, so EQ rows carry no expect.
